review.description: C-ANSWER now explicitly rejects native responses while requested interruption is still stopping the agent. Other entity identities, connection endpoints, containment and browser contracts retain their existing behavior.
review.implementation: C-ANSWER maps Manager.Answer directly; its native branch rejects the durable interruption flag under the existing session lock before answer effects. Async/text answers and visual dialog handling remain unchanged. Generated UI tables expose the authored interaction and assertion mapping.
review.tests: Inspected the new API-NATIVE-ANSWER-INTERRUPT assertion and its barrier test: rejected valid native answer leaves store/session requests pending and creates no private reply; interrupted completion marks stale. Existing fixture logs show regression sensitivity and surrounding answer/recovery preservation. This backend assertion does not close installed-host or accessibility gaps.
